note: contrat de prêt de 50 M$ de la filiale taïwanaise avec la filiale taïwanaise de HSBC, non renouvelé ; solde remboursé le 9 septembre 2024, non tiré depuis
quote: On December 20, 2024, the General Loan, Export/Import Financing, Overdraft Facilities, and Securities Agreement which the Company, through its Taiwan subsidiary, had entered into with the Taiwan affiliate of HSBC Bank (the "Loan Agreement") was terminated and not renewed.
